# Earthlink Consultants

> UK-based education consultancy serving applicants in 120+ countries, with featured study destinations and clearly separated UK immigration support.

Earthlink Consultants Limited was incorporated on 9 October 2014 and has traded continuously since then. It is now based in Harrow and serves applicants in 120+ countries worldwide. Earthlink may handle university applications and supported non-UK visa work; Stonebridge Legal Solutions alone provides UK immigration advice and handles every UK visa route, form, and application. Recruitment support is limited to helping jobseekers find suitable employers, strengthen applications, and prepare for interviews; Earthlink does not procure sponsorship or arrange sponsor licences.
